title: open-model-phylogeny: Phylogenetics of Open Models
description: Reproducible pipeline, results and figures for a phylogenetic analysis of the Hugging Face Hub, built from the lineage that models declare (fine-tunes, adapters, quantisations and merges). Companion software to the working draft "Phylogenetics of Open Models: Structure, Hybridisation, Tempo and Speciation in the Hugging Face Lineage Graph". Lineage data: Open Model Family Tree by h9-tec (CC BY 4.0), derived from the cfahlgren1/hub-stats dump of Hugging Face Hub metadata (Apache-2.0).
